body.deadline_description: Final pay post-promotion (SDCL 60-11-10): If termination occurs post-promotion, ensure all wages earned at promoted rate from effective date forward are paid by next regular payday. Employee may demand written immediate payment (due within 5 days). If employee returns all property, no holdback permitted.
